messages:
sam_marketing: Heads-up — want to run a small experiment on the pricing calculator copy + tier naming for EU locales. Two things: 1) add a compact tooltip explaining 'metered units' (what counts as a unit), 2) try alternative tier labels (Starter / Scale vs Basic / Pro). Plan: A/B test funnel + webinar CTA. Thoughts?

maria_growth: love it. metrics?

sam_marketing: primary: CTA click -> demo/webinar signups, secondary: calculator completion rate, bounce on pricing page. Also track per-locale conversion and help center searches.

ben_devrel: can we make tooltip content translatable? i18n keys? also suggest adding a short example: '1 message ~ 2 units' — users love concrete examples.

jess_prod: @ben_devrel yep. Suggest variants:
- V1: tooltip short + 'See examples' link to micro FAQ
- V2: inline one-liner under calculator, no tooltip
- V3: tooltip + tier rename to 'Starter / Growth / Enterprise'
Need test sizes.

oliver_growth: what traffic split / duration should we aim for?

sam_marketing: start with 10% of organic traffic, run 2 weeks or until 3k calc interactions. If effect on demo signups > 10% lift we promote. Can we do heatmap on CTA too? :mag:

jess_prod: allocate 10/10/80 for V1/V2/control? or 5/5/90 to be conservative.

maria_growth: recommend 5/5/90 initially, then ramp.

designbot: mockups uploaded: https://figma.com/redwood/pricing-tooltip-mocks — feedback welcomed. small copy options in figma: "A unit equals ~1 short chat turn (up to 100 tokens)."

ben_devrel: quick implementation note for the calculator frontend:
```
pricingCalculator.update({ locale: 'de', tooltip: true, variant: 'v1' })
```
Also add analytics event `pricing_calc_tooltip_shown`.

sam_marketing: who can own toggles and rollout?

jess_prod: I'll own rollout + metrics. @oliver_growth can you set KPI dashboard?

oliver_growth: yes, will set funnel and p50 latency for calculator (we've seen slow calc -> drop-offs)

maria_growth: should coordinate webinar copy to tie to variant messaging. If V1 wins, webinar angle: 'How metered pricing works for product teams' — short 20 min.

ben_devrel: thumbs up. also let's seed a short FAQ snippet: 'How do units map to tokens?' link.

sam_marketing: OK, action items:
- jess_prod: create experiment config + runbook
- ben_devrel: implement analytics + i18n keys
- designbot: finalize copy variants in figma
- oliver_growth: dashboard
- maria_growth: webinar copy + promo plan

sam_marketing: target launch to experiment next Tue. Ping me with blockers. :sparkles:
